facts.text: “Two slices, one fizz, then the floor. That’s Saturday.”
facts.why: Tony never says this and it is set in quote marks. It is an invented line, although the two stacked slices on 86th Street are real.
facts.fix: Set it as an unquoted note from Tony: two slices, one fizz, then the floor.

facts.text: Crisp-cut potatoes under hot beef gravy and melted mozzarella. For after the last dance.
facts.why: The dish note is a plain serving suggestion for a diner side and claims nothing about the plot.
Mr. Fusco gives Tony a raise on payday (a crummy $2.50, which Fusco then jokes up to $4), so the word RAISE on the pay prop is true.

vibe.verdict: Strong neon floor, white suit ticket and the 86th Street slices, with one invented quote and a couple of shaky props.
